widgets_values: b3@ut1f0ll_r@in. A cinematic continuous video using the same main subject from the reference image, consistent identity, consistent outfit, natural camera motion, coherent lighting, realistic intimate motion, stable temporal consistency.

segment 1: A static, slightly high-angle shot focused on a cracked asphalt puddle reflecting storm clouds and lightning. The surface is still except for tiny ripples from falling raindrops that haven’t yet started. A distant rumble of thunder rolls in low and deep beneath everything else.

|

segment 2: Camera fixed on the puddle: The rain picks up rhythmically now — steady drumming on the pavement, louder each second until individual droplets become blurred streaks falling into the puddle’s surface with forceful impact bursts that splatter outward. Each drop lands at a different point around the center of reflection.

|

segment 3: Camera stays on the puddle: The rain intensifies dramatically into downpouring sheets. Raindrops strike with such force that ripples surge violently outward from every point of impact until entire sections become turbulent chaos.
